summary: Use an unmapped arguments object for strict functions and for functions with non-simple parameter lists.

target.notes: The unmapped arguments object stores the originally supplied values independently from later writes to named parameters. Out-of-range property reads produce undefined.

semantics.index_read: ordinary property semantics over captured supplied values

caveats: Default/rest/destructured parameter lists cause unmapped arguments even in non-strict code.
If the arguments object escapes and is mutated with descriptors, helper must model ordinary-object property semantics.

tests.name: strict param write does not update arguments
tests.input: function f(a){'use strict'; a=9; return arguments[0]}; console.log(f(1));
